scope: Final C4 application runtime measurement limitations
admission: Native builds, gates and benchmark jobs use shared admission. This is not isolation from every host process or read-only analysis.

coordinator_search.activity: Broad read-only rg file search across sibling worktrees, subsequently terminated
coordinator_search.cpu_affinity: Default process affinity; not separately pinned
coordinator_search.bounds_source: Adjacent coordinator clock observations; exact process timestamps were not logged

other_activity: Lightweight coordinator progress polling and report preparation occurred during collection.
interpretation: CPU affinity does not eliminate shared cache, memory or filesystem effects. Preserve all samples and censors. Review matched ranges and overlap in the final regression screen; do not describe these observations as a completely quiescent host or attribute small differences to one implementation change.
